newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah says Israeli casualties in Lebanon raid.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah says Israeli casualties in Lebanon raid.

text.p: Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah said its guerrillas attacked an Israeli army post in south Lebanon on Saturday, causing damage and casualties.

Hizbollah (Party of God) said in a statement in Beirut its fighters fired anti-tank rockets and machineguns at Blat post in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, destroying a Mirkava tank and "killing and wounding a number of soldiers."
Pro-Israeli militia sources in the south Lebanon zone said the Blat post was attacked by guerrilllas but said initial reports showed one Israeli soldier was wounded.

Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war on Israeli and allied South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia forces in a bid oust them from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep zone set up by Israel in 1985 to deter cross-border guerrilla raids on its northern settlements.
